items.item_text: Acquires new information resources and maintains continuing access to ongoing resources in all formats.
Performs functions related to ordering, copy cataloging, and payments for new and existing information resources in all formats and acquisition modes.
Uses established guidelines to acquire and maintain print and electronic serials
Completes reconciliation and processing of the library’s consortial invoices.
Works closely with TCCS Financial services in ensuring financial operations related to information resources acquisitions and material budget management.
Works closely with the division Director and Managers to follow best practices, policies, procedures, and guidelines relating to acquisitions, print and e‐resource management, and copy cataloging.
Monitors acquisitions group email accounts and/or help tickets and responds as needed.
Communicates effectively with vendors, staff, and patrons.
Provides assistance in answering task- or project-related questions asked by student staff.
Assists with collections and acquisitions-related data gathering and analysis projects.
Collects usage data per established workflows.
Improves system and application skills in order to increase efficiency and knowledge of library resources.
Assists with projects prioritized in the division as needed.
Participates in library-wide activities by leading and serving on teams, committees, and task forces.
Perform other related duties as assigned.
